title: Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.14277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tensor parallelism ends every layer with an all-reduce that sits between two dependent matrix multiplications, so its cost cannot be hidden and grows as compute outpaces interconnect bandwidth. Sending 4-bit instead of 16-bit values would cut this cost by nearly 4x, but the all-reduce must add the values it carries, and rounding the sum injects an error at every call. Model quality depends on how these errors accumulate over layers, yet existing methods treat each call on its own. We present Echo, a 4-bit all-reduce for training and inference that controls the accumulated error. Echo moves data in 4 bits and sums in high precision, so each value is quantized at most twice per call for any number of GPUs. The summation reveals each injected error, and Echo feeds it back into later calls, so old errors cancel instead of accumulating. We prove that the accumulated error stays bounded independently of depth. On A100 GPUs, Echo is 2.09x faste

translated_title: Echo：面向大语言模型训练与推理的误差补偿4比特张量并行通信
translated_abstract: 张量并行在每一层结束时都需要执行一次 all-reduce（全归约）操作，该操作位于两个相互依赖的矩阵乘法之间，因此其开销无法被隐藏，且随着计算速度超越互连带宽而不断增长。用4比特替代16比特传输数值可以将这一开销降低近4倍，但 all-reduce 必须对其携带的数值进行求和，而对比和进行舍入会在每次调用时注入误差。模型质量取决于这些误差在层间的累积方式，然而现有方法将每次调用独立处理。我们提出了 Echo，一种用于训练和推理的4比特 all-reduce 方法，能够控制累积误差。Echo 以4比特传输数据、以高精度进行求和，因此在任意数量的 GPU 下，每个数值在每次调用中最多只被量化两次。求和过程使得每个注入的误差得以显露，Echo 将其反馈到后续调用中，使旧的误差相互抵消而非不断累积。我们证明累积误差保持有界，且与网络深度无关。在 A100 GPU 上，Echo 的速度快2.09倍（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: Echo 提出一种误差补偿的4比特 all-reduce 通信方法，通过高精度求和与误差反馈机制让量化误差相互抵消而非累积，在保持有界累积误差的同时将张量并行通信开销降低近4倍。
